analogs.covers: Body and daily life: a loud, sociable river fisher that rests on the banks in a small group and takes on crocodilians
Mind: a calculating opportunist in small loose groups that bluffs with its voice and profits from a bigger partner

headline: A screaming giant otter with a coyote's calculating mind, and a cuckoo's trick for getting Spinosaurus to raise its young.

setting.label: Drifts between resource-rich lakes and rivers
setting.note: Nomadic and semi-aquatic; hunts in water and on land, and tries to stay and nest close to a Spinosaurus.

playsLike: You are a large semi-aquatic carnivore in a 'snare' of up to 3. You fish readily, stalk other semi-aquatics and take to land to hunt dinosaurs up to Apex tier (never Spinosaurus). You prefer vocal intimidation to real fights. Your master plan is to be 'adopted' by a Spinosaurus that feeds you, and to nest right next to it so it mistakes your young for its own. Any other Suchomimus near 'your' Spinosaurus is attacked. Against land predators you retreat into the water.

why.text: Readily eats fish and stalks other semi-aquatics, as giant otters live on fish and also kill caimans and anacondas.
Hunts Deinosuchus and Sarcosuchus to keep the fish to itself, but only when confident. Giant otters likewise take on caimans as a group.

Profile: 'a vocally aggressive species first and foremost'. Screeches and roars come first, squabbles over fish rarely go past a snap. Giant otters are among the loudest predators of South America and bicker noisily while eating.
Naps often in shallow water and on banks, sleeps beside its snare and enjoys 'swimming - or just floating - under the water together', like a giant otter family resting on a sandbank.
'Cunning and opportunistic… always on the lookout for an easy advantage', always taking 'the path of least resistance'. That is the coyote (official inspiration).
Nests next to Spinosaurus hoping its young are mistaken for Spinosaurus young. That is brood parasitism (official inspiration: cuckoos).
Large tier, 5,000 combat weight, 700 HP; land sprint 950, water sprint 640.

notLike: Giant otters are territorial and mark their stretch of river; Suchomimus is nomadic and claims no territory.
Giant otters are small; Suchomimus is a Large-tier carnivore that chases land prey up to Apex tier without limit.
Coyotes have no big patron; Suchomimus's whole strategy revolves around Spinosaurus.
twist: Looks like a gharial (official inspiration) with its long fishing snout, chews shells and piles kelp into a bed like a sea otter, and floats together like bottlenose dolphins (official inspiration).
